cases.name: Gamma energy matching
cases.question: Which line is energy compatible?
cases.inputs: Analytical fixture E=100.6, Eref=100, u=(0.3,0.4,0.5) keV
cases.method: Quadrature marginal uncertainty and signed normalized residual
cases.source: Analytical uncertainty fixture; IAEA for production photon data
cases.limits: Compatibility does not establish parent identity; missing uncertainty uses a declared non-statistical window.

cases.name: Candidate ranking
cases.question: Which parent has independent support?
cases.inputs: Two exact, exclusive independent analytical lines
cases.source: Explicit project scoring model, not an IAEA probability
cases.limits: Uncalibrated ranking points; contradictions are separately assessed.

cases.name: Multi-line consistency
cases.question: Are correlated centroid residuals consistent?
cases.inputs: Residuals (1,1) keV; independent u=1; common ucal=1
cases.source: Closed-form matrix inverse; JCGM covariance framework
cases.limits: Gaussian energy diagnostic; no count chi-square, p-value or presence probability.

cases.name: Missing expected lines
cases.question: Should an unobserved line exceed the declared sensitivity threshold?
cases.inputs: Anchor N=1000; P=(0.5,0.25); efficiency=(0.1,0.2); threshold=20; complete list; assessed response
cases.method: Detector-weighted anchor ratio and lower expected-mean bound
cases.source: Analytical simulated response, explicitly declared; no experimental claim
cases.limits: Requires complete sensitivity/uncertainty information and a pure anchor; not proof of absence.

cases.name: Shared-line ambiguity
cases.question: Does the observed group have competing parents?
cases.inputs: One 100.05 keV fixture peak; Sim-A=100, Sim-B=100.1
cases.method: Distinct compatible parent sets per independent group
cases.source: Analytical ambiguity fixture, not real nuclide records
cases.expected: One shared group containing Sim-A and Sim-B
cases.limits: Discriminating lines still need detector-sensitivity assessment.

cases.name: Relative intensity consistency
cases.question: Do response-corrected ratios agree?
cases.inputs: Equal 1000-count net areas; P ratio=0.5; efficiency ratio=2
cases.method: Observed area ratio versus P*efficiency*s ratio; diagnostic log residual
cases.limits: No raw-area/probability comparison; low-count and unassessed-model residuals withheld.

cases.name: Mixed-isotope attribution
cases.question: Which bounded parent sets explain the independent groups?
cases.inputs: Separate Sim-A 200 and Sim-B 300 keV supports; unexplained 888 keV
cases.method: Enumerated cover objective with component penalty
cases.expected: Best set Sim-A+Sim-B; coverage 2/3; unexplained u
cases.limits: Bounded search, no activity or concentration fractions.

cases.name: Evidence coverage
cases.question: How much listed evidence is explained?
cases.inputs: Two peaks; only first explained; weights (3,1); net areas (10,90)
cases.limits: Listed-area fraction excludes continuum and unlisted counts; none is a probability.

cases.name: Alternative hypotheses
cases.question: What does the specified centroid-density model predict?
cases.inputs: One exact 100 keV fixture centroid; u=0.1; q=0.9; range width 980 keV
cases.source: Closed-form likelihood independent of the implementation
cases.limits: One model is not a relative comparison; relative likelihood is never a posterior probability.

cases.name: Evidence report
cases.question: What conclusion is justified by the compound evidence?
cases.inputs: One exact, exclusive line; no quantitative detector model
cases.method: Conservative verbal synthesis and explicit limitations
cases.source: Declared project rules; validated analytical single-line boundary
cases.limits: Uncalibrated research classification, not a definitive isotope certificate.
